title: Omega-3 Pufa and Aspirin as Adjunctive Therapy in Treatment of Smoker Patients With Stage Iii Periodontitis

sections.abstract: Background: Smoking reduces the effect of non-surgical periodontal therapy, a host modulation regimen consisting of omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (ω-3 PUFA) supplementation with low-dose aspirin (ASA) with or without systemic doxycycline has been proposed to improve treatment response. The Aim of the study is to explore the clinical effects of orally administered omega-3 PUFA and ASA with or without systemic doxycycline with periodontal debridement in treatment of smoker individuals with stage III periodontitis.
